hero.intro: Full-stack engineer based in Nigeria, building secure, high-performance systems with React, Node.js and AI. I turn complex requirements into software that holds up under real traffic.

paragraphs: I'm a results-driven software engineer based in Nigeria with a Computer Science degree from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology. I specialise in full-stack development with a deep focus on system design, AI integration, and building APIs that hold up under real traffic.

Beyond writing code, I care deeply about architecture — how systems communicate, fail gracefully, and grow without breaking. I've cut load times by half, boosted user engagement by 35%, and reduced production bugs significantly across the products I've worked on.
I hold certifications in React/Next.js (Udemy, Jonas Schmedtmann) and Python (CPD Accredited, TIL Career). I believe great software is an intersection of engineering rigour and product intuition.

principles.title: Architect first
principles.body: I design before I code. SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns are my default language — not an afterthought.

principles.title: AI-native
principles.body: RAG pipelines, LLM APIs, vector search — I build AI features that genuinely improve user experience, not gimmicks.

principles.title: Performance obsessed
principles.body: Redis caching, query optimisation, and lazy loading are habits. I've cut load times by 45% and boosted engagement by 35%.

principles.title: Test-driven
principles.body: 90%+ test coverage across core services using Jest, Mocha, and Cypress. I ship with confidence, not hope.

highlights: Architected full-stack apps with React.js + Node.js/Express.js using SOLID principles and Clean Architecture — reducing codebase complexity by 15%.
Integrated OpenAI and Claude LLM APIs for intelligent auto-complete, summarisation, and chatbot UIs — boosting user engagement by 35%.
Built a RAG-based document Q&A interface with vector embeddings enabling semantic search across 10,000+ records.
Implemented Redis caching on critical API routes, cutting data load times by 45%.
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and containerised services with Docker for consistent zero-downtime deployments.
Led Agile/Scrum ceremonies across cross-functional teams, accelerating delivery cycles by 20%.
Conducted end-to-end vulnerability assessments on web applications, identifying and remediating OWASP Top 10 risks including SQLi, XSS, CSRF, and broken access control.
Performed application security (AppSec) reviews — analysing source code for insecure patterns, hardcoded secrets, and logic flaws before production deployment.
Reduced security vulnerabilities by 40% across audited applications through systematic dependency audits, security header hardening, and input validation enforcement.
Authored detailed vulnerability reports with CVSS severity scores, proof-of-concept exploits, and actionable remediation steps for development teams.
Integrated SAST tooling into CI/CD pipelines to catch security regressions automatically on every pull request.
Advised on secure authentication design — JWT hardening, OAuth2 flows, RBAC models, and session management best practices.
Built mobile-first accessible websites contributing to back-end Express.js APIs, increasing mobile traffic by 80%.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and session management following OWASP security best practices.
Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest and Mocha, reducing production bugs by 30%.
Reduced security vulnerabilities by 40% through dependency audits, input validation, and security headers.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility across 5 major browsers with 100% error-free rendering.
